about: Rules a script can test on a rendered page, for the UI hub page checker (bin/pagecheck.js). kind: dom = query the DOM; axe = run axe-core; perf = PerformanceObserver; viewport = load at fixed sizes. Selectors in quotes are suggestions; use the hub's own class or data-node conventions where they exist.

checks.title: Every screen says where you are and how to leave
checks.test: document.title is unique across routes and contains the H1 text; exactly one nav link has aria-current="page".

checks.title: One primary action per view
checks.test: Within each view root and each [role=dialog], at most one button styled primary ([data-variant="primary"] or the hub primary class).

checks.title: Text and controls meet contrast minimums
checks.test: axe rule color-contrast: 0 violations, in light and dark theme.

checks.title: Targets are big enough to hit
checks.test: axe rule target-size (24x24 CSS px) passes; at a 390 px viewport, buttons and links are at least 44x44.

checks.title: Icons carry a text label
checks.test: Every button or link whose text content is empty has an aria-label or aria-labelledby.

checks.title: Labels sit above fields and never vanish
checks.test: Every input, select and textarea has a label (for/id, wrapping label or aria-labelledby); a placeholder alone fails.

checks.title: Left-align text; right-align numbers in tabular figures
checks.test: In each table, columns whose cells parse as numbers compute text-align: right and font-variant-numeric containing tabular-nums.

checks.title: Write for scanning: say it once, most important words first
checks.test: No h1-h4, label or button text runs past 8 words; no visible string longer than 3 words appears twice in one view.

checks.title: Tables: numbers right, headers fixed, rows that respond
checks.test: Data tables use table, thead and th[scope]; the thead is position: sticky inside a scrolling table.

checks.title: Every chart has a text title and a text alternative
checks.test: Each chart (svg[role=img], canvas, or [data-chart]) has a visible title and an aria-label, aria-describedby or adjacent table.

checks.title: Speed is a feature: meet Core Web Vitals and reserve space
checks.test: PerformanceObserver layout-shift total under 0.05 over load plus 5 s (hub-0010); every img has width and height or aspect-ratio.

checks.title: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA, with semantic HTML first
checks.test: axe-core: 0 serious or critical; exactly one main landmark and one h1.

checks.title: The hero says the outcome, and its one action is above the fold
checks.test: At 1280x800 and 390x844, on landing routes, the h1 and the first primary button are fully inside the first viewport.

checks.title: The footer is the site map and the contact desk
checks.test: On site routes, exactly one footer or [role=contentinfo]; it contains a mailto:, tel: or contact link.

checks.title: At most one announcement, and it never looks like an ad
checks.test: At most one [data-node="section/announcement"] (or role=region named announcement) per page; none on checkout or signup routes.

checks.title: Badges only for what changes a decision
checks.test: No list item or card holds more than 2 badges ([data-node="atom/badge"] or the hub badge class); each badge has text content.

checks.title: Tooltips add detail; they never hold what you need
checks.test: Every element with a tooltip (aria-describedby to [role=tooltip], or the hub tooltip trigger) is focusable (tabindex >= 0 or native control).
